# Lens: a stone post holding a glowing prism at the beam's height (1.27 m), the source of the
# sunbeam on the court's west side. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Stone --base-color 0.1569 0.1020 0.1765 --no-slot
material new Glow --base-color 0.9333 0.1412 0.2392 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Post --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.560
scale 0.220 0.220 1.120
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Foot --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.060
scale 0.500 0.500 0.120
apply --scale
select Post Foot
active Post
join
material assign Stone
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name Prism --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location 0 0 1.27
scale 1 1 1.2
apply --scale
material assign Glow
select Post Prism
shade flat
export lens.glb
